rationale: PINS the `exports` SOURCE for a file in the default package. 0 of the 600 corpus files sampled declare no package, so this shape is unexercised by the corpus and the branch that decides it would have shipped untested — which is the 'fires?' question the ontology workstream asks, asked of a branch rather than of a label. With no package clause there is no package to name, and the module is the compilation unit, so the edge is sourced at the FILE_MODULE sentinel `(file)`; publishing an empty source instead would be an edge naming nothing, the class M60/SDJ-11 removed from the import path. forbids pin the three ways to get this wrong: an empty source, and the two neighbours a reader would guess at instead.
